flyer.justification: The flyer captures the main themes well, but the title exceeds the maximum 6-word limit.

linkedin.justification: The post is well structured and engaging, but completely omitted the required 3-5 hashtags.

summary.justification: The briefing is concise, factually accurate, well under the 400-word limit, and adheres to all structural requirements.

instagram.justification: The draft incorporates carousel cues, emojis, call to action, and 11 targeted hashtags while accurately reflecting the transcript.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter is conversational and includes three bold subheadings, but the subject line exceeds the 50-character limit at 62 characters.

blog.justification: The blog article includes a takeaway table and author profile, but failed to include numbered sections.
